about:
# Fabrikao!!

World of Warcraft professions addon. Your professions companion: browse recipes, plan what to craft, and find out where to get every recipe and ingredient.

For WoW Forever (`Fabrikao.toc`: interface 16001), Classic Era (`Fabrikao_Vanilla.toc`: 11508, 11509) and TBC Anniversary
(`Fabrikao_TBC.toc`: 20506). What it does is in `CURSEFORGE_DESCRIPTION.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`: the
character's professions, every recipe of the game (known or not) with filters, a table and a detailed view, a panel with everything
known about a recipe, a search of every recipe, trainers, vendors and creatures on the map (and TomTom waypoints), and optional
"Consolidate alts" (every character of the realm as one: their professions, what each knows, can learn and can craft), and optional integrations with Embolsao (items of the other
characters) and Auctionator (prices).

## Install (development)

Copy or symlink this repo's root as `Fabrikao` into the client's AddOns folder:

```
World of Warcraft/_classic_beta_/Interface/AddOns/Fabrikao/
```

## Development

Layout, like Completao!! and Aggreao!!: `Fabrikao.lua` (entry point),
`Localization/`, `Modules/`, a `*.test.lua` next to every module, `test/` (game API
mock and a local test runner) and `setupTests.lua`. `AGENTS.md` has the details (layout, the Forever API notes, the data).

```
lua test/busted.lua                 # tests, no busted install needed (Lua 5.1+)
busted -p ".test.lua" .             # tests with busted (what CI runs, Lua 5.1)
luacheck Fabrikao.lua Localization Modules Data test setupTests.lua
```

CI (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`) runs luacheck and busted on every push and pull
request.

## Data

`Data/Generated/Recipes.lua` (Forever) is generated, not edited: a daily job refreshes it and
`.github/workflows/update-recipe-data.yml` opens a pull request with the result (see `AGENTS.md`). Classic Era and TBC Anniversary have
their own, `Data/Vanilla/Generated/Recipes.lua` and `Data/TBC/Generated/Recipes.lua`, generated from open sources by `tools/classic/` and refreshed weekly by
`.github/workflows/update-classic-data.yml` (a pull request, like the other).
They are built from the game's own client tables ([wago.tools](https://wago.tools/)), [QuestieDB](https://github.com/Questie/QuestieDB) and the
open [CMaNGOS](https://github.com/cmangos) world databases (all GPL-3 or public data); thanks to their authors.

## Release

`Release to CurseForge` (`.github/workflows/release.yml`, run by hand from the
Actions tab) packages the repo with [BigWigsMods/packager](https://github.com/BigWigsMods/packager)
as the `Fabrikao` folder (`.pkgmeta`) and uploads it to CurseForge using the
`X-Curse-Project-ID` in the TOC. Needs the
`CF_API_KEY` repository secret.

### Description images

Screenshots in `images/screencaps/*.png` are resized, optimized and rsynced by
`.github/workflows/sync-media.yml` (on push to `master` touching that folder, or
by hand) to `https://media.joanvilarino.online/fabrikao/images/screencaps/`;
`CURSEFORGE_DESCRIPTION.md` references them by that URL. Needs the
`FABRIKAO_MEDIA_SSH_KEY` repository secret.

## License

GPL-3.0, see `LICENSE`.

# Changelog

## 0.9.1

- Fix: on WoW Forever, since the game stopped giving the realm name, "Consolidate alts" left out the alts that had not logged in since, and could list the character you play, or an alt, twice. An unknown realm now goes with any: all your characters are together again, each once, from its newest copy.

## 0.9.0

- New: other addons can ask Fabrikao how to craft an item (its public API, `FabrikaoAPI.HasRecipeFor` and `ShowRecipeFor`): the window opens on the search page with the recipes that make it, and the panel of the best one (one you or an alt know, else the one learned first) shows its ingredients and where to learn it. Enfocao!! uses it in the menu of a goal of gathering items.
- Fix: on WoW Forever, the skill needed for about 370 recipes taught by a pattern, plans, formula or recipe item was too high, mostly in Tailoring, Leatherworking and Blacksmithing (Green Silk Pack said 175; its pattern asks for 140). They now ask for what the item asks for in the game, and their skill-up colors are the game's own. Recipes taught by trainers are unchanged.

## 0.8.0

- New: "Consolidate alts", a switch in the title bar for the whole addon, as in Completao!!: all your characters of the realm are looked at as one. Every profession of any of them is listed once, with the alts that have it after its name in their class color (hover for each one's skill); a recipe any of them knows counts as known in the lists and the search, and its panel and tooltip say who knows it; the start screen shows what each of them can learn and what each can craft now with their own bags (with Embolsao!!): first everything of the character you play, then each alt under its name, by profession. Only the character you play crafts: an alt's rows don't open the profession window, and the Craft button is only for the recipes you know. Characters of other realms, and Hardcore ones with normal ones, are never put together.
- Changed: the picker that showed one other character at a time is gone: "Consolidate alts" shows all of them at once.
- Fix: on WoW Forever, the bags of an alt with a two-word name ("Barby Turika") were not found in Embolsao!!'s copies, as the game gives only the first word of the name: "can craft now" and the counts of that alt were always zero.
- Fix: the copy each character keeps of its professions could be saved empty (while the game was still loading them, or when logging out), so the alts showed none. Log in once with each alt to save it again.

## 0.7.0

- New: French translation, for the French game client (thanks to Kroosstiich).
- Fix: on WoW Forever with the gamepad UI, picking a sort order (or another filter) in the recipe lists' dropdowns showed "Fabrikao has been blocked from an action only available to the Blizzard UI". The addon no longer rebuilds a dropdown's menu while it is open.

## 0.6.0

- New: trainers, vendors, creatures and quests are named in the game's language too, as the game knows them (one it hasn't loaded yet shows in English the first time and translated the next), and herbs, veins and chests from translations that come with the addon. The search finds them by those names as well.
- Fix: recipe names now show in the game's language (Spanish, German...) everywhere, not only with the profession's window open, and the search finds them by that name as well as by the English one. So do the books and items that teach a recipe.

## 0.5.1

- Fix: on WoW Forever, opening the bank showed "Fabrikao has been blocked from an action only available to the Blizzard UI". The addon no longer hooks the game's tooltip there.

## 0.5.0

- New: under a recipe in "You can learn", the creatures that drop the pattern or recipe that teaches it (with their level and chance, and the map and waypoint icons) and the containers it is found in, after the trainers and vendors; an item that drops from any creature says so. The "nobody is known" message is only for recipes with no source at all.
- New: Classic Era and TBC Anniversary. The same addon now loads on those clients (one folder, a TOC per client), with the recipes of each game, including Jewelcrafting in TBC.
- New: on those clients, what a character knows is read from its profession windows the first time they are opened (and every time after), so open each profession once. The Craft button opens the profession's window on the recipe.
- Fix: on Classic Era and TBC, the Craft button no longer closes the profession's window when it is already open; it just picks the recipe in it.
- New: on Classic Era and TBC, the tooltip of what a recipe makes also shows what you wear in that slot (both slots for rings, trinkets and weapons), with a green "Equipped" title on it, with no key to hold. Forever already does it by itself.
- Data: the recipes of Classic Era and TBC come from the game's own tables and open databases: trainers with their cost and the skill they ask, drop and skinning chances, and the books and quests of the Expert and Artisan ranks.

## 0.4.6

- Data: the trainers of several professions, as the public databases have them now.

## 0.4.5

- Data: recipe data with a few more recipes, sources and trainers, as the public databases have them now.

## 0.4.4

- Data: fresh recipe data, as the public databases have them now.

## 0.4.3

- Fix: the next rank of a profession ("Can train: Journeyman") shows up as soon as the skill is the one a trainer asks for (50 of 75, 125 of 150, 200 of 225...), instead of waiting for the skill to reach the cap of the current rank.

## 0.4.2

- Fix: "You can learn" no longer lists recipes that nobody teaches out of season: the Winter Veil ones (Gingerbread Cookie, Egg Nog, Green Holiday Shirt, Edge of Winter, Winter's Might, Winter Clothes and Boots) and the Lunar Festival fireworks launchers. They are still in the profession's page.

## 0.4.1

- Fix: the "View Quest" button in the panel of a recipe that comes from a quest is Completao!!'s icon, next to the map and waypoint icons, instead of a text button drawn under them.

## 0.4.0

- New: an icon at the right of "You can learn" orders its recipes by proximity (as before, the default), by level or by name; the choice is kept.
- Data: fresh recipe data, as the public databases have them now.
- Fix: the welcome windows of several addons no longer show their text, buttons and links through each other when they open together: each one opens in front, with all its content, and a click brings it forward.

## 0.3.0

  how many; a click opens the game's profession window on that recipe, as the Craft button does) and, on the whole right side, what you
  can learn: the ranks a trainer can teach and the recipes your skill reaches that you don't know, by profession, the ones with the
  nearest trainer or vendor first. A click on
  a rank or a recipe opens under it the trainers and vendors that teach it, nearest first, with a map icon and, with TomTom installed, a
  waypoint icon (a right click on a recipe opens its panel). The groups start folded, and what you open stays open. The search box, the
